curated.conceptDesc: A glowing holographic dragonfly whose wings are spinning multi-core processor threads, routing millions of luminous data packets between memory cores at microsecond speed
curated.oneLiner: The 25x faster modern replacement for Redis — built for multi-core CPUs with 80% less memory overhead.
curated.notes: High on the VidiSmart Masterlist. Eliminates Redis single-thread bottlenecks for real-time agent swarm telemetry.
curated.origin: Oded Poncz & Roman Gershman (2022) · Next-Gen In-Memory Architecture

smartStack.label: Next-Gen Multi-Threaded Cache
smartStack.headline: In-Memory Caching is evolving from single-core Redis to multi-threaded Dragonfly
smartStack.description: Redis was designed 15 years ago for single-core servers. Dragonfly redesigns memory storage for modern 64-core AI hardware, delivering 4M+ queries/second on a single instance.

legacyStack.label: Single-threaded Redis core
legacyStack.note: Bottlenecks on 1 CPU core while 63 cores sit idle

legacyStack.label: Complex cluster sharding
legacyStack.note: Requires dozens of nodes, complex proxies, and sentinel scripts

legacyStack.label: OOM memory spikes
legacyStack.note: Can crash when taking background memory snapshots

newStack.label: Multi-threaded C++ engine
newStack.note: Runs simultaneously across every CPU core with zero lock contention

newStack.label: Single-node simplicity
newStack.note: Handles millions of operations on one server without cluster complexity

newStack.label: Smart memory compression
newStack.note: Stores up to 3x more data in the same RAM with zero snapshot crashes

anatomy.desc: Key-value records, token counters, and queue payloads stored directly in high-speed memory.
Harnesses every CPU thread simultaneously for 4M+ queries per second.
Custom shared-nothing thread architecture eliminating queue bottlenecks.

flow.title: AI Swarm Request
flow.desc: 80 agents simultaneously request real-time session tokens.

flow.title: Dragonfly Core
flow.desc: Multi-threaded C++ engine processes across all 64 CPU cores.

flow.title: Microsecond Read
flow.desc: Data returned in under 200 microseconds with zero queue lock.

flow.title: Instant AI Response
flow.desc: User receives real-time agent output with zero perceptible lag.

senses.definition: A predatory flying insect of the order Odonata, suborder Anisoptera, characterized by an elongated body, two pairs of broad wings held flat when at rest, and a life cycle including aquatic nymphs; widespread near freshwater habitats and used as model organisms in studies of insect flight and vision.
examples: Dragonflies are studied for their rapid wingbeat and agile aerial maneuvers.
Larval dragonflies develop in aquatic environments before metamorphosis.
